text:
leah: Heads-up — eu1 saw a sudden rise in 5xxs and p95 after the morning deploy (model-redwood-3.2.1). Asking for quick mitigation options: region pin or full rollback?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert: eu1 /generate 5xx rate 12% over 6m. Canary fraction: 10%. Active variant: model-redwood-3.2.1. Suggested: region-pin to last stable or rollback image. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/fast-rollback

toni: Quick triage: traces show GPU mem pressure and repeated KV cache misses; logs include `GPU_MEM_ALLOC_FAIL`.

ops-lead: Policy: >10% 5xx for 5m -> mitigate. I approve region pin to v3.1.9 for eu1, skip canary to speed mitigation. Notify support.

leah: Executing: `/deploy pin model-redwood-3.1.9 --region eu1 --skip-canary --reason "post-release 5xx spike" --ticket INC-3500`

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Preflight OK. Rolling to 100% in eu1 with short ramp.

toni: Running 12-case smoke now.
toni: smoke: all green — latency and output sanity look fine.

deploy-bot: Pin complete. model-redwood-3.1.9 active in eu1. 5xx rolling avg back to 0.7%; p95 near baseline.

support: Notified CS; prepping customer blurb re: potential tokenization diffs.

releasebot: Draft note: "Region pin in eu1 to v3.1.9 to mitigate elevated 5xx after v3.2.1 rollout. Investigation ongoing; postmortem INC-3500." Link: https://go/redwood/prs/5201

ops-lead: Keep region pinned for 2h, collect GPU heap dumps from affected pods, and decide next steps after telemetry.

leah: Filed INC-3500 and assigned follow-ups. Closing fast path unless regressions appear. Thanks all.
